description:
Meet the 12% AHA Body Scrub – your expert-formulated fix for strawberry skin, rough bumps, and tanning. Now boosted with 2% Glycolic Acid, it deeply exfoliates and reveals visibly smoother, clearer skin – all without harsh scrubbing.

✨ What’s Inside?
🔬 12% AHA Blend – A powerful mix of Glycolic & Lactic Acid that gently resurfaces skin and clears clogged pores 
🌾 Oat & Aloe Extract – Soothes irritation and deeply hydrates for soft, calm skin 💧
🛡️ Vitamin E – Strengthens the skin barrier and protects against dryness

Upgrade your scrubbing routine with our advanced formula! 🚀

Step 1: Take a handful of scrub on your palms.
Step 2: Apply on damp skin & massage in gentle, circular motions.
Step 3:  Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm/cold water.

Use 1-2 times a week for 3 months for best results!

faqs.question: Can I use 12% AHA Body Scrub every day?
faqs.answer: No, we recommend using this body scrub for all skin types once-twice a week

faqs.question: Is cleanser good for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this body scrub can be used by all skin types.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

faqs.question: Do I need to use this before or after soap?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to clean before exfoliating, hence best results are seen when scrub is used after using soap or body wash.

faqs.question: How does this help with de-tanning?
faqs.answer: Our 12% AHA Body Scrub effectively helps remove tan by combining the power of physical and chemical exfoliation. The natural silica beads gently scrub away dead skin cells, while lactic acid dissolves the top layer of tanned skin, revealing a brighter, more even complexion.

faqs.question: Are there any side-effects?
faqs.answer: No, there are no side-effects of this product.  But a patch test is recommended prior to use.

faqs.question: How does it remove strawberry skin?
faqs.answer: Our 12% AHA Body Scrub effectively targets strawberry skin by combining physical and chemical exfoliation. The natural silica beads unclog pores and remove dead skin cells, while lactic acid gently dissolves impurities. Oat extract, known for its skin barrier-protecting properties, soothes and hydrates the skin, reducing redness and irritation often associated with strawberry skin. Regular use helps refine skin texture and improve overall skin clarity.

faqs.question: Will it make my skin dry?
faqs.answer: Our scrub exfoliates gently and lactic acid present attracts and retains moisturise,  which leaves your skin feeling soft and moisturised.

faqs.question: What do I need to do before and after scrubbing?
faqs.answer: Before using scrub, gently cleanse your body to remove dirt, excess oil, using a body wash or soap. After exfoliating, it is recommended to use a body lotion or moisturizer.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Our scrub is gentle on skin, so it will not cause any harm to sensitive skin.  But it is recommended to do a patch test, especially for sensitive skin to test it out prior usage.

faqs.question: Can someone below 18 use it?
faqs.answer: We recommend only women above 18 years of age to use it.

faqs.question: Can men use it?
faqs.answer: All our products are designed keeping women’s needs in mind and are recommended for women above the age of 18. While men can definitely use it, we cannot guarantee the efficacy for men. Also we have a separate website for men’s care products. To visit it please click here https://manmatters.com/ .
